name: Grettle
description: A scarred, heavyset goblin wearing a stolen shepherd's cloak as a badge of rank, taller and steadier than the raiders she commands.
disposition: Ruthless towards anyone weaker and quick to abandon anyone who is not; she rules the lair through fear and will preserve herself over any fight she is losing.

traits: Knows the wall crack in the lair hollow by feel and can force it in the dark without slowing down.
